payload.title: Lab classifier P1: Hosted transformer implementation
payload.description:
DynamoDB-backed CurationJobs, front handler, task entrypoint running PapyrusPrimingCuration unchanged, SSRF-safe authorize_source (https only, no private/link-local/metadata addresses, re-check after redirects), per-job budget on DynamoDB.
Acceptance: contract tests for idempotency, feedback and cancel; no AppSync/registration writes.

Size: L
Dependencies: Cyclotron C1 (wiring; both sides develop against fakes), I6/I7 for deployment
Epic: Lab is the single classifier per publication (PPY-922416). Cyclotron-side epic: decision-flywheel-1b8b860d.

Approved by Ryan 2026-10-22; AWS changes need his explicit approval.
